message.content: {"caption":"Workflow diagram of SkillOpt’s batch-level skill optimization and epoch-wise slow/meta update process.","description":"A flowchart shows a fixed agent using a trainable skill document to produce a rollout batch from the training split. The rollouts are divided into minibatches, which optimizer models use to propose add, delete, or replace edits. A batch-level merge deduplicates and resolves conflicts; edits are ranked and clipped under a scheduled budget, then applied to form a candidate skill. A validation gate accepts the candidate as the current skill or sends rejected edits to a buffer, while the best validated skill is recorded. A lower epoch-wise update loop compares previous and current skills, summarizes improvements, regressions, persistent failures, and stable successes, and uses reflection and a meta-skill optimizer for slow updates to future model calls. The test split is shown as locked until the final report.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
